use_case_name: Share a Geographic Pointer with Other Units

evidence_cards.content: The C² JU shall assume R² of an IU (including C² and nonC² JUs and forwarded PUs and RUs) in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track if the C² JU has correlated local sensor data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the high-level objective (goal) of the use case: to report an Interface Unit (IU) as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG when specific conditions are met.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 message is used to exchange tactical information about geographic references (such as waypoints, Combat Air Patrol stations, Forward Edge of the Battle Area) and has the capability to transmit lines such as FEBAs, roads, etc.; areas such as search areas, exercise areas, etc.; and volumes such as corridors.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific goal of sharing geographic pointers (points, lines, areas, volumes) via the J3.0 message format.

evidence_cards.content: Common tracking is defined as sharing of a common track number and shifting R2 between C2 JUs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence defines the specific objective (sharing a common track number) that the primary actor (C2 JU) wants to achieve, directly filling the 'goal' slot for the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The C² JU shall extrapolate the received target's position to the time of transmission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a specific objective/action for the Primary Actor (C² JU) regarding data processing during the sharing/translation process.

evidence_cards.content: A J7.3 message provides the capability for C² JUs to designate a geographic position and up to twenty characters of text on one or more C² JU's displays.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This sentence explicitly states the high-level objective (goal) of the use case: enabling C2 JUs to share geographic pointers with other units via the J7.3 message.

evidence_cards.content: A geographic filter allows a JU to filter tracks and nonC² IUs based on their geographic location.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the core objective of the primary actor (JU) in using geographic filters, which is directly related to the goal of sharing a Geographic Pointer with other units — as filtering by location is the functional purpose of such pointers.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must have correlated local sensor data before it can assume R2 of an Interface Unit (IU).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a mandatory state (correlated local sensor data) that must exist for the C2 JU to proceed with reporting rules for an IU, which is a necessary condition for tracking and subsequent sharing actions.

evidence_cards.content: When the remote report being tested for correlation is a J2.2 Air or J2.3 Surface PPLI message, the maximum positional error associated with the reported Geodetic Position Quality (Qpg) shall be used for the value of R in the position test.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a mandatory system state condition regarding how positional error values are derived from Qpg for correlation testing, which must hold before the use case can proceed correctly.

evidence_cards.content: If the received J2.2 or J2.3 Qpg = 0, the PPLI shall not be correlated automatically.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a critical precondition where the system must prevent automatic correlation if the quality indicator is zero, establishing a boundary condition for the use case execution.

evidence_cards.content: The unit originating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report always retains reporting responsibility.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the mandatory pre-condition of retained reporting responsibility for the originating unit before any sharing action can occur.

evidence_cards.content: It is illegal to assume reporting responsibility for another unit's J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report.

evidence_cards.content: Each unit initiating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report shall assign a TN not known to be in use on the interface even if it is believed that such a report may concern the same emitter currently being reported in another J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report by another unit.

evidence_cards.content: A TN pair must be determined to be a dual designation.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates any of the following conditions exist: (1) The two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict; (2) The two tracks have different Mode II codes, and the local Mode II code is current; (3) Both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks; (4) Either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Lists specific restriction conditions that prevent automatic correlation between tracks, serving as exceptions to the normal flow.

evidence_cards.content: J3.7 messages transmitted by nonR² JUs with the Response Indicator set to value 1 shall not affect reporting responsibility.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception condition where a specific message type and indicator setting do not alter system state or responsibility — relevant for exception_flow as it describes a non-effect outcome under specified conditions.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.2 message may be used to correlate EW AOPs with surveillance tracks, but shall not be used to correlate EW LOBs and fixes with surveillance tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a restriction on usage of J7.2 message — constitutes an exception flow constraint by prohibiting certain correlations even when technically possible.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R², upon receiving or initiating a J7.5 (ACT = 0) message that results in no IFF/SIF data being held on the track, shall not continue transmitting the periodic J3 message that includes the continuation word containing IFF/SIF data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an exception flow where a specific condition (no IFF/SIF data after J7.5 ACT=0) triggers a change in system behavior (stopping periodic J3 transmission), which is an error/unexpected condition handling path for the C2 JU when sharing geographic pointers if those pointers rely on IFF/SIF data continuity.

evidence_cards.content: Any JU may change a local mode to a No Data status without transmitting a J7.5 (ACT = 0) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This represents an exception flow where the normal protocol (transmitting J7.5 ACT=0 to clear modes) is bypassed — indicating an alternative error-handling or administrative override path that avoids standard messaging, relevant to exception scenarios in geographic pointer sharing if mode changes affect display integrity.

evidence_cards.content: A geographic filter allows a JU to filter tracks and nonC2 IUs based on their geographic location.

evidence_cards.content: Maximum and minimum altitude values may also be defined for each filter that make it possible to describe volumes.

evidence_cards.content: Filters can be fixed geographically, slaved to the filtering JU or some other moving reference point, or move independently.

evidence_cards.content: An AOP resulting from previously reported LOBs shall be assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the LOBs.

evidence_cards.content: The new TN shall be used for all subsequent updates of the AOP.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.0 message is used to effect the following management actions on the interface: Dropping or ceasing to report a track; Reporting differences in Environment/Category and/or ID; Changing Environment/Category and/or ID.
